title: ST Metro Ruins Datapack
description: Adds in simple metro-like ruins, still a WIP.
body:
This datapack adds in world generation for a monorail metro tunnel structure that may or may not have side shafts. Includes custom made jigsaw structures and custom loot tables, unfortantely I can't make them larger without going beyond a datapack. 

This datapack is not complete and is a work in progress. I just wanted to publish it for fun.

To locate in game use /locate structure stmetro:metro_structure
Otherwise is generates around 34 blocks underground in various biomes which are listed in the has_metro file.

Built with Axiom and worldedit, some files generated using misode's json generators.
